content: So all of a sudden, out of nowhere, I can't sign into the app. I have no problem signing in on my web browser. Even did so and changed my password but, even with the new password, still can't sign into the app. Care to explain Netflix? I've been a customer since 2016 for Christ's sake. This is wrong.
The only home feature ruined netflix, now when I try to sign in from any device, it says I need to watch it either temporary or to sign out. Now I can't even watch it. Terrible experience.
It refuses to sign me in and so even after it agrees it still has something up it's sleeve so I have nothing good to say

Trying to log in with different deivce, password is incorrect (on my other device i can get in just fine with my current password), so i change my password, put in the new password, and apparently its incorrect! (Of course it works on my other device). When i try to use the sign in code, it conveniently says that there are too many log in attenpts, honestly i think i would rather watch pirated content.

Unable to sign in. My password works fine when I sign in on Google, but it keeps saying invalid password or email on the app. Update: I can finally sign in, but the app keeps cutting off while I am watching, and when I go back on Netflix to continue to watch whatever I was watching, it starts back to the beginning. It also keeps switching the subtitles on.

App Does Not Work!!!! I keep getting a (-74) error when I tried to log in earlier. I tried uninstalling and reinstalling the app multiple times. I restarted my phone. Now the app crashes, it does not even open!! There is no issue with my internet and my Netflix account works with other devices. The app simply does not work. I have a Samsung Galaxy A5 btw.

I'm giving it one star for now. I've been loving Netflix until a few days ago that it stopped working. I can't control it using my Google TV Remote and when I try to stream it on my phone and cast it on the TV it won't connect. I've tried with other apps and they are working just fine. Did all the troubleshooting and I'm still stuck at the profile page

I use Netflix all the time normally. However, recently the app on my phone will not display any video. Audio and subtitles etc are all working as normal, but I just can't watch anything with no visuals. It's nothing to do with my phone or WiFi as all other apps are working fine and Netflix is working on my TV. It seems to be an issue just with the mobile version

It will not play and no reason for it not to!!! Netflix is working on my phone but randomly stopped working on my Android tablet. Netflix have been EXTREMELY unhelpful. I have tried everything to get it working again with no luck at all. Not happy. Paying for a service I cannot fully use. Rubbish customer service!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

Update: I uninstalled and reinstalled the app with no change, I still cannot watch anything on my phone. Needs an update, please fix! After the last update I've had issues watching on my phone. I can cast to my google hub and it plays fine. I go back to viewing on my phone and it starts up fine but then it freezes, with the audio still playing. Did restart my phone, etc. But nothing seems to help.

The previous to last version kept crashing every time I landed on Home. Then I completely removed the app and installed the latest update, hoping that the update would fix the issue. It keeps crashing also. I don't know if you guys changed your web services or something else, but it seems the app crashes waiting for new data. It is a shame, the Netflix app used to be very stable and with a great user experience.
New update suck! Can't find anything i was watching before. Man, time to leave netflix for good. So annoying!

New update and layout for home screen is awful!!! It makes me not want to watch netflix anymore, I can only see one title at a time, my list isnt easily readily available and it bugs all the time. I do like the continue watching button taking you to your watching selection but thats about it. Please being back the old layout. It was infinitely more better than what the newest update has to offer.

Netflix is trash. Ever since the latest update, I can't get it to work on my Oculus or my Samsung smart TV because apparently, neither of them support ads. Well, guess what the new update was so generous to put in everything. ADS, so now I have to? Upgrade my plan, which means? You guessed it PAY MORE MONEY. Just another way to con people into having to pay more for garbage. No thanks, I'll take my money elsewhere.

Pre-installed App doesn't work sometimes stuck on the intro screen, need to wait for multiple updates for the app to start working again, can't even uninstall it. And it's lucky if the app even works after the new update. Happens Everytime when Netflix release some update for the application. Sometimes the app works after the update, some other times it will stop working for months with multiple updates coming until a working update is released. Device : OP 8 Pro

It's good. You can have more then one profile. You can download movies and shows to watch when offline, and you can watch a large variety of shows. It sucks how they remove shows and movies so quickly sometimes, and how Netflix has become so greedy cause billions aren't enough, so now we have to pay to share accounts. Wow thanks mate. Greedy people.

I love the netflix app but now its pointless. I loved being able to have access to all the episodes in a season now that it only comes out once a week I don't see the difference or point of using only Netflix. I understand if it is like that with certain TV shows but not their own shows. I might as well just watch regular tv and wait for the episodes to come on weekly.

Netflix used to be good. Yes, there are great shows on it and they make great shows. However, the price increases keep on increasing and with the end of account sharing, I decided to delete it. If I can't even share my account with my wife or watch shows while on vacation, I don't see the value anymore. Now I've freed up so much time for social and personal persuits that I don't ever see myself going back.

What is happening to this company! The last app update for my TV makes the app unusable. Nothing loads, it deletes my continue watching shows. It's just bad. Not a good selection and they keep cancelling shows. There's no longer any pride in providing a good service. They wouldn't even be happy if everyone in the world had a subscription, they'd find a way to sell it to you for double. Nothing is enough.

i am dissatisfied with the service. now new movie ia found to watch. we can watch movies in this quality on youtube for free. netflix should atleast newly released movies after a month but we cant find movies even after six months of their release.... useless to waste money for monthly subscription when you have to watch decades old movies

Netflix gave me a really great time. But now, I can't watch anything at all. When I press a movie/series I wanna watch, it just keeps looping "loading..." I've waited for more than 5-10 minutes but nothing happened. Even the ones I downloaded already, they won't play. Please fix, I wanna watch again ಠ﹏ಠ and it also keeps saying "there is a problem playing the video." Even though i already downloaded it. How annoying
The App will not update to anything I watch on TV Netflix, annoying to say the least. I watch Netflix alot, may reconsider.......

What is going on?? I can't watch any movie downloaded for offline play. But when I stream online it plays. This is not nice. I have reached out to your chat assistant. Made me download another movie yet it didn't play. Still rolling forever with a blank screen. I can't have a subscription, then stream movies online, when I can download and watch at my convenience. Please fix ASAP.

Terrible update. 2/17/24, and I cannot watch anything. I have been unable to watch anything since yesterday after I updated the app. It keeps spinning to load what I want to watch and never actually plays. The price increase to almost $26 makes this even more ridiculous and absolutely not worth keeping. Would not recommend anyone even bother with Netflix anymore. There are better and cheaper options that actually work.

I am very frustrated that for some reason when I go to watch something, the video will play for less than a minute then freeze or turn black screen and the audio will keep playing. I've had the app on my phone for less than 3 weeks and it only worked for ONE day and then started messing up again. I Don't understand what's going on but please fix this issue.

They've raised the price to $11.99 per month for the basic account. I was already dissatisfied with it at $9.99 for several reasons, but primarily because they're the only streaming service that only allow one screen per account. Everything else let's you have at least two because they know one person typically watches on both TV and a mobile device. They mentioned nothing about any new features or improvements to justify the price change and will probably still cancel the good content.

Consistently getting worse!! Algorithm does a poor job of guessing what I want and locks into only having exposure to a handful of things. The new household policy doesn't account for people who split time between two houses! I refuse to pay extra because I split time. Trying to add games? Just all going down hill. So many other services. I plan on canceling my subscription.

I joined netflix for the first month, it demands for all card details and to choose a plan. the money got deducted from my account, but i couldn't get the subscription and its been one day now.. i'm not satisfied with the service they provide against such plan amounts. Also, i tried to call netflix all the time but it didn't respond. Directed as switched off. Kindly, get back to me to resolve this problem once you will be active.

I was in the middle of watching a movie and it kept freezing, never had this problem before. I decided ok, I will update the app and see if it fixes it. Nope, instead I was booted from the family account. Good move Netflix, your service is so expensive with little choice. I'll consider subscribing to prime instead (way more value for the money) as well as sticking to the free services available. One of many very disappointed users!

Yeah probably time to cut my Netflix subscription. I've always paid for premium to get HD and 4k content. I've paid for it since it was $10, then $12, then $14, then $18 and now $20! Fine whatever, but now they are implementing these new password sharing rules because they aren't making enough money but not lowering any prices on the tiers themselves. There's also no option to get 4k content without paying for 4 simultaneous devices. What a racket.

Application has stopped opening on my Samsung s10+ in the last two weeks or so. Still giving the same error code (Sorry, we could not reach the Netflix service. Please try again later -1023). I've done the usual: tried restarting the app, updating it, and restarting my phone and it's still happening. I'll happily update this review once fixed. Thanks!

It worked great until an update a few months ago. Started working again until a few days ago when I started getting the same error message. Using a Pixel 2. I get "Sorry, we could not reach the Netflix service. Please try again later. (-1001)". I've checked permissions, uninstalled and reinstalled, restarted my phone. Nothing works. I get no answers from Support either.

Since the last update the app doesn't work properly. Everytime I want to use it, I get the same error message "Sorry, we could not reach the Netflix service. Try again later. (-1023)". This happens when I use mobile data and also when I use WIFI. The only way to make it work is by uninstall the app and install it again (and use it ASAP) or cleaning the data of my phone.

I love this app but for the past several days I cannot get it to load on my phone. I have uninstalled and reinstalled, didn't help. Getting a message saying couldn't reach Netflix service, try later, then (-1001) with option to select OK, then the app closes. Help! Watching on my phone is my main way of using Netflix, I pay monthly for a service that I don't have access to. This isn't okay.

Been trying to use it for a week now and whenever I opened it it is showing me the error that " sorry, we couldn't reach the netflix server. Please try again later". I have tried to uninstall and install, clear cache and cookies and I even downloaded the app using third party software but none of it works. Please fix your bug. I dont want to pay for something I cannot use in the first place.
